page.notes: The marginal notes on the left are set in small type and partly hyphenated across lines; the readings "argenti au-riq; signā-di" and "Rem-pub. pervi-tentes" are uncertain and may be misread. "LXXXVIII" is uncertain and marked [?]. The word "rum" at the bottom right is the catchword, not a foot note; it is listed under the foot note element only because it completes the hyphenated word "assesso-rum" and should be checked. A faint stamp at the bottom right corner is not transcribed.
